function.name: remember
function.description: Store an explicit memory statement or extract atomic facts from conversation text. Use `content` for direct storage (preferences, facts, goals, etc.) with automatic deduplication and conflict superseding. Set `extract=true` to automatically analyze conversation turns and extract isolated facts.

parameters.description:
Store explicit memory or extract facts from free-form conversation text.

Designed for AI tool use: pass `content` for direct storage or `text` with `extract=true`
to isolate atomic facts automatically.

examples.content: User prefers concise Python code snippets.

examples.text: I just moved to Seattle and I work as a systems engineer.

content.description: Direct memory statement to store. 'content' or 'text' must be provided.
examples: User prefers concise Python code snippets.
content.title: Content

text.description: Free text or conversation turn from which to extract memories when extract=true, or alias for content.
examples: I just moved to Seattle and I work as a systems engineer.
text.title: Text

type.description: Category of the memory: preference, goal, skill, profile, fact, or other
type.title: Type

importance.description: Importance score from 0.0 to 1.0. Defaults to 0.5 (or model-assessed when extract=true).
importance.title: Importance

confidence.description: Confidence score from 0.0 to 1.0 that this memory is accurate and truthful.
confidence.title: Confidence

source.description: Source identifier (e.g. system name, conversation ID, tool call).
source.title: Source

extract.description: When true, passes text through the LLM extraction pipeline to isolate atomic facts.
extract.title: Extract

user_id.description: Target user identifier (optional; automatically derived from authenticated API key when auth is enabled).
user_id.title: User Id

metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON metadata attributes to attach to the memory.
metadata.title: Metadata

function.name: recall
function.description: Retrieve relevant user memories for a query, ranked by multi-factor relevance (semantic similarity, importance, recency, and access frequency). Returns a structured list of memories and a pre-formatted, character-budgeted `context` markdown string ready for system prompt injection.

parameters.description: Search and retrieve user memories ranked by semantic relevance and recency.

examples.query: What are the user's favorite programming languages?

query.description: Natural language query or question describing memories to retrieve.
examples: What are the user's favorite programming languages and editor preferences?
query.title: Query

limit.description: Maximum number of memory items to return.
limit.title: Limit

type.description: Optional filter: preference, goal, skill, profile, fact, or other.
type.title: Type

user_id.description: Target user identifier (optional; automatically derived from authenticated API key when auth is enabled).
user_id.title: User Id

min_similarity.description: Minimum cosine cutoff (defaults to service retrieval_min_similarity).
min_similarity.title: Min Similarity

function.name: forget
function.description: Delete a user memory either by its exact UUID (`memory_id`), or by semantically finding the best match for a `query`. When searching by query without `confirm=true`, the endpoint returns the candidate memory awaiting confirmation. Pass `confirm=true` to confirm permanent deletion.

parameters.description: Delete a memory by ID or search for it semantically with confirmation.

memory_id.description: Exact UUID of the memory to forget/delete.
memory_id.title: Memory Id

query.description: Semantic search query to find the memory to delete if memory_id is unknown.
query.title: Query

confirm.description: Confirmation flag. When false and using query, returns candidate memory without deleting. When true, permanently deletes it.
confirm.title: Confirm

user_id.description: Target user identifier (optional; automatically derived from authenticated API key when auth is enabled).
user_id.title: User Id

function.name: profile
function.description: Retrieve a compact summary of the user's active memories organized by category (preferences, profile, goals, skills, facts). Returns a pre-assembled markdown profile ready for context injection.

user_id.description: Target user identifier (optional; automatically derived from authenticated API key when auth is enabled).

limit.description: Max active memories to include in summary (default: 20).

function.name: capabilities
function.description: Inspect service version, active embedding model details, supported memory categories, enabled security features, and operational limits.
